land.text: the County of Lippe, promoted to a principality in 1789

predecessors.note: The Principality of Lippe page dates the principality to 1789; the county-of-lippe dossier ends in 1806, the year Cliopatria's Principality of Lippe row begins.

land.text: the state as it stood in 1870, unchanged to November 1918 (Free State of Lippe)

successors.note: The state was a federal state of the German Empire from 1871 and ended in November 1918 (see the dissolve event); the Weimar Republic took over its land (Free State of Lippe). The German Empire was its overlord, not its successor, so it is no longer listed here (fx-53 D01, was the 1871 dissolve into german-empire; same change as fx-46 R122 for Bavaria); the hierarchy.csv row principality-of-lippe -> german-empire (constituent, 1871-1918) is for the orchestrator.

correction.text: the unchanged principality of 1806-1865, member of the North German Confederation from 1866

keyframe_review.note: The 1866-1869 shape (719.6 km2, two cells) drops the third cell of the 1820-1865 shape (8.79E, 52.05N, about 253 km2) that Lippe had since 1806. The page records no boundary change for 1850, 1851, 1853 or 1866: in 1866 Lippe joined the North German Confederation, and it appears in the Austro-Prussian War page only in the list of Prussian allies. Keep the 1820 shape.
Same two cells as 1866 (719.6 km2). No territorial change is recorded for 1866-1871; 'In 1871, Lippe became one of the states of the German Empire'. Keep the 1820 shape.

region.text: the Principality of Lippe around Detmold, an imperial estate since the county and a principality since 1789

ledger.note: 1806: Lippe is a sovereign principality. 'Lippe was promoted to the status of principality in 1789' (Leopold I first prince); the infobox gives Confederation of the Rhine membership 1806-1813, the text 'In 1807 Lippe joined' it (the Confederation page: Lippe-Detmold joined on 11 April 1807). Cliopatria's row starts in 1806, the year the Empire ended; the county-of-lippe dossier gives 1806 as its end.

region.text: the state's outline as it stood in 1870, unchanged to November 1918

ledger.note: 12 November 1918: the prince abdicates. 'The Principality of Lippe came to an end on 12 November 1918 with the abdication of Leopold IV, becoming the Free State of Lippe' (infobox 'German Revolution: 12 November 1918'); infobox status 'Federated State of the German Empire (1871-1918)'. Federal state of the German Empire from 1871 ('The other states retained their own governments but had only limited aspects of sovereignty', German Empire page). Was a dissolve in 1871 into german-empire; moved to November 1918 and the counterpart changed to weimar-republic on the 3 Nov 2026 fix (fx-53 D01, as fx-46 R122 did for Bavaria): the Empire was this state's overlord, not its successor.

wars.name: Austro-Prussian War
wars.outcome: Lippe is on the Prussian side; no territory changes hands. It joins the North German Confederation in 1866 and signs a military convention with Prussia in 1867.
wars.note: The Austro-Prussian War page lists Lippe only among the Prussian allies and gives no territorial change.

certainty.note: A small state whose frontier the page never describes; the Lippstadt-side exclaves (Lipperode, Cappel) and the borders with Prussia, Hanover, Waldeck and Hesse are below the 253 km2 grid cell. 1872-1918 (fx-53): the dossier records no frontier change after 1871; the state keeps its 1870 outline as a federal state of the German Empire.

sources.title: Confederation of the Rhine
sources.note: 12 July 1806 founding and member joining dates (Wurzburg 23 Sept, Saxony 11 Dec 1806, Lippe 11 April 1807); dissolved 4 Nov 1813.

sources.title: Austro-Prussian War
sources.note: 15 June 1866 Prussian invasion of Hanover, Saxony and Hesse-Kassel; Peace of Prague 23 Aug 1866; Bavarian losses.

sources.title: Principality of Lippe
sources.note: 1789 principality; Confederation of the Rhine; German Confederation 1815; North German Confederation 1866; German Empire 1871; no boundary change documented 1815-1870; 1,215 km2 (1910).

sources.title: German Empire
sources.note: Constituent states: the other states retained their own governments; all ruling kings, dukes and princes abdicated in November 1918.

sources.title: German revolution of 1918-1919
sources.note: Abdications: by the end of November 1918 the dynastic rulers of all the other German states had abdicated.

notes:
END YEAR: 1871 (German Empire); the principality lasted to 12 Nov 1918.
NO TERRITORIAL EVENT: the Principality of Lippe page documents no gain or loss after 1789 and says so for 1850, 1851, 1853 and 1866; the 1866 Cliopatria cell loss is therefore rejected rather than explained. The only dated constitutional steps are association events (Confederation of the Rhine 1806/1807-1813, German Confederation 1815, North German Confederation 1866, German Empire 1871), which are not territory.
CONFLICTS: infobox membership of the Confederation of the Rhine 1806-1813 against 'In 1807 Lippe joined'; the page does not give the 11 April 1807 date the Confederation page does. Rulers: the page lists Leopold I 1789-1802, Leopold II 1802-1851, Leopold III 1851-1875, Woldemar 1875-1895, Alexander 1895-1905, Leopold IV 1905-1918; only the reigns that touch 1806-1871 are used.
PREDECESSOR: county-of-lippe (batch eu-09-x) has the same Lippe on the same land with end 1806; no territory changes hands.
Page budget up to 5: Lippe, Confederation of the Rhine, Austro-Prussian War. REALM OF MEMBER STATES (fx-53 D01, 3 Nov 2026): this state now lives to November 1918 as a federal state of the German Empire, which 'retained their own governments' (German Empire page: 'The other states retained their own governments but had only limited aspects of sovereignty'; 'the Kaiser and all German ruling kings, dukes, and princes abdicated' in November 1918) and the German revolution of 1918-1919 page: 'By the end of the month, the dynastic rulers of all the other German states had abdicated without bloodshed'. Changed: identity.end 1871 -> 1918/11; the 1871 dissolve into german-empire became a 1918/11 dissolve into weimar-republic; successors german-empire -> weimar-republic; last keyframe (principality-of-lippe_1870) carried to 1918 ('to'); capital and certainty to 1918. The german-empire dossier no longer gains this land in 1871 nor lists the state as a predecessor, and weimar-republic lists it as a predecessor (fx-53 D02, D04). The hierarchy.csv row principality-of-lippe -> german-empire (constituent, 1871-1918) is for the orchestrator.
